notes.title: Reason for delaying the release of the game
notes.notes:
Dear Wishlisters,

I am really sorry to make you all wait this long for the release. There is a problem with the release as I (the developer) have joined a gamedev company and thus it is now a bit tricky for me to release the game under my name. It's a purely bureaucratic problem. Sorry to all the players and let me ensure you that once this problem is solved (which depends on my company's guidlines), the game will be released asap. I use the time to make improvements and fix remaining bugs. Let's hope for the best!

Love you all!
